earnings.title: CSX Corp. Announces Third Quarter 2026 Results
highlights: Record quarterly revenue of $4.02 billion, up 12% year-over-year; diluted EPS of $0.57, up 54%
Operating income of $1.57 billion, up 44%; operating margin expanded 880 bps to 39.1%
(NASDAQ: CSX) today announced third quarter 2026 operating income of $1.57 billion and net earnings of $1.05 billion, or $0.57 per diluted share.
In the third quarter of 2025, the company reported operating income of $1.09 billion and net earnings of $694 million, or $0.37 per diluted share.

Excluding a non-cash goodwill impairment of $164 million in last year’s results, third quarter 2025 adjusted operating income, net earnings, and EPS were $1.25 billion, $818 million, and $0.44, respectively.

quotes.text: CSX delivered strong earnings growth in the third quarter as disciplined execution helped us move more freight, for more customers, while maintaining our high standards for safety and service.
quotes.by: Steve Angel, president and chief executive officer

items.heading: New legislation, regulatory changes or other governmental actions could impact the Company's earnings or restrict its ability to independently negotiate prices.
Government regulation and compliance risks may adversely affect the Company's operations and financial results.

CSXT, as a common carrier by rail, is required by law to transport hazardous materials and could be adversely impacted by non-compliance with applicable regulations or from regulatory and legislative changes.
The Company may be subject to various claims and lawsuits that could result in significant expenditures.
Network or supply chain constraints could have a negative impact on service, operating efficiency or volume of shipments.
CSXT, as a common carrier by rail, transports hazardous materials, which could expose the Company to significant costs and claims in the event of a train accident.
